title: Integral formula T(ω) = ∫⟨ω, ξ⟩ dμ_R for an integer multiplicity triple
statement: Let P, n be natural numbers, U ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) : IMRep U n, and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n: a C^∞ n-form on ℝ^P with compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ U). Let μ_R = R.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity θ. Then the function x ↦ ξ(x)(ω(x)) is μ_R-integrable, and R.action ω = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) equals ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ_R(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Integrable (fun x => R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) R.measure ∧ R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = ∫ x, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂R.measure
